response.text:
I can’t directly update your public status page. I can, however, produce the exact postmortem content (Markdown/HTML) ready to paste and give the small publishing steps. Please either paste the approved writeup here or confirm you want me to format the previously shared draft. 

Below is a ready-to-paste Markdown postmortem template. Replace the bracketed placeholders with the approved text or details, then paste into your status page editor.

Suggested metadata (if your status system supports front-matter):
---
title: "Postmortem: [Service] outage on YYYY-MM-DD"
status: resolved
severity: major
components: [component-name]
start: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ
end: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ
authors: [Name(s)]
---

Postmortem: [Service] outage on YYYY-MM-DD

Summary
A brief one-sentence summary of what happened and the impact.  
(e.g., "On YYYY-MM-DD between HH:MM and HH:MM UTC customers experienced partial or full interruption of [service], affecting [scope].")

Impact
- Who was affected: [customers/internal users/regions]
- What was affected: [API, dashboard, ingestion, etc.]
- Severity: [major/partial/degraded]
- Duration: [total downtime]

Timeline
- HH:MM — Detection: [how it was detected]
- HH:MM — Initial response: [actions taken]
- HH:MM — Mitigation: [temporary/rollback steps]
- HH:MM — Recovery: [final fix applied]
(Include additional timeline items as needed, with timestamps in UTC.)

Root cause
Concise statement of the root cause.  
(e.g., "A configuration change to [component] caused [failure mode], which resulted in [impact].")

Contributing factors
- Factor 1 (e.g., insufficient validation in deploy process)
- Factor 2 (e.g., monitoring alert thresholds too high)
- Factor 3 (if any)

Resolution and remediation
- Immediate fix applied: [what was done to restore service]
- Permanent remediation planned or implemented:
  - Action 1 (owner, ETA)
  - Action 2 (owner, ETA)
  - Action 3 (owner, ETA)

Customer communication
- How and when customers were notified (status page, email, Twitter)
- Any guidance customers should follow now

Follow-up / action items
- [Action item 1 — owner — due date]
- [Action item 2 — owner — due date]
- [Action item 3 — owner — due date]

Learnings
- Short bullets of lessons learned and improvements to process or tooling.

Links
- Incident runbook / timeline: [link]
- Internal incident doc: [link]
- Related PRs or config changes: [link]

If you want, I will:
- Format your approved writeup into this template and return the exact Markdown to paste (paste the approved text here), or
- Produce an HTML version for immediate upload if your status page requires HTML.

Also, tell me which timezone/timestamp format you prefer and whether you want a short status-summary line (one sentence) to appear at the top of the status page; I can generate that too.
